import urllib.request, os

output_dir = 'tasks/t0080_bedb_mobo_v3_dendritic_spike_nsga2/assets/paper/10.1101_2020.09.15.297937/files'
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, 'goethals_2020_axial-current-ais-nav-rgc.pdf')

pdf_url = 'https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.09.15.297937v2.full.pdf'
print(f'Downloading: {pdf_url}')

req = urllib.request.Request(pdf_url, headers={
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; research-agent/1.0; mailto:a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk)',
    'Accept': 'application/pdf,*/*'
})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
    content = r.read()
    print(f'Downloaded {len(content)} bytes, status={r.status}')
    print(f'Content-Type: {r.headers.get("Content-Type", "unknown")}')
    
with open(output_path, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(content)

print(f'Saved to: {output_path}')
print(f'Starts with PDF: {content[:4] == b"%PDF"}')
